stemMarkdown: Evaluate $\dfrac{1}{1 + \sqrt{5}}$ as a decimal. (Round to 6 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Multiply top and bottom by the conjugate $1 - \sqrt{5}$: $\dfrac{1 - \sqrt{5}}{1^2 - 5} = \dfrac{1 - \sqrt{5}}{-4} = 0.309017$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Rationalising does not change the value — it just moves the irrational part to the numerator.
